name: winter-demo
description: A Winter terminal in a webview, painted by Winter's own renderer over stdio.

winter.serverPath.description: Path to the winter-frame binary. Defaults to target/debug/winter-frame(.exe) in the first workspace folder.

winter.fontSize.description: The point size the server measures its face at. Takes effect on the next opened terminal.

winter.shell.description: Program the server runs. Defaults to PowerShell on Windows (7 before 5.1) and $SHELL on macOS and Linux.
